notes.title: Update 1.12 released!
notes.notes:
The latest Player's Eleven update has been released! With version 1.12, some improvements have been introduced, a few bugs have been eliminated and some balancing has been done - so everything is as usual! Below you can see what has changed!

If you still want to play with version 1.11, that's no problem. Just select the beta "Version 1.11" on Steam. Click for instructions

Features


Upgrading and downgrading round. Twice per season there is now an upgrade and downgrade round for the squad.
The players' grades are now saved for the whole season. In the player menu you can see the current average grade.
[The number of eleven-of-the-day nominations is now saved. At the end of the season you can see the eleven-of-the-season.
[Skin selection: In the start screen and in the settings you can now select a skin. A great overview of different skins can be found on the P11 Discord Server.
In the editor you can now easily move a player between teams.


Balancing

The required salary for players without a contract has been increased slightly.
The allowed budget overrun has been moved down slightly.
Transfer free players are now chased a little more by CPU clubs.
There was a very small bonus for the human player - this has now been removed. P11 should not be too easy ;)


Removed bugs

The correct value for condition and freshness is now displayed for substituted players.
Changing the duration of the goal display now works.
Various settings are now applied permanently.
A crash bug at the end of the season has been fixed.

notes.title: Version 1.11 online!
notes.notes:
After the update is before the update!

I am very, very happy to announce the release of version 1.11 today! Again, I have received an incredible amount of feedback, and almost all new features are based on it. Many thanks to all players! Unfortunately I could not take everything into account, it was just too much for that. But don't worry, of course we're still working on Player's Eleven, so you can expect more features in the near or even more distant future. But enough talking, the following things have been improved or added in version 1.11

Features


 Calendar view. You can now see different dates: Friendly matches, fan parties, youth days or farewell games. Your fans will be happy - if they show up!
 Complete revision of the youth section: You can now recruit U19 players from other teams, you can see the history of the U19 and an overview of the U-19 champions
 Potential of the players: Depending on the level of the scouting department you can now see the potential of a player! See even clearer young talents!
 For the fans there is a new category: International fans! Achieve success in the European Cup and increase your fanbase outside your home country
 Budget adjustment. You don't want to expand your terrain and put the whole remaining budget into the squad? No problem anymore!
 Own club: You cannot be dismissed from your own club. Also, your own club will always appear on the list of available offers if you are unemployed. You can also support your own club and send money to it under certain circumstances.
 Possibility to cancel the contract with players. You can't get rid of a player? No problem, for a small compensation he is surely willing to cancel his contract with you
 Abbreviations for the table: Who became (W)inner, (C)upwinner? Who is (N)ew and who is (R)elegated?
 Who watches your stars? Check which of your players is on the sheets of opposing teams. Maybe it is time for a contract extension?
 Tactics evaluation of other players. How well does a player match your tactics? 
 Watchlist for the transfer market. Collect interesting players in a separate list
 Display only realistic candidates to personnel. Who would be willing to change?
 After a matchday the original tactics and line-up will be restored
 In the European Cup there is now a colored marking for the placements
 You can now hide loans on the transfer market



Balancing


 Revision of the youth players and scouted players. These now fit better to the rating of the club
 Better AI line-ups. These have been slightly improved
 Fan calculation for stadium visitors revised again
 Youth players demand slightly lower salaries
 Account balance view now more detailed



Bugfixes

What bugs? Just kidding, a few small bugs were found & fixed!


 The game no longer crashes after a play-off game. There was a bug hidden in the post-game report screen
 If you cancel a player's contract, but the player was lined up and you switch to the tactics menu, the game will no longer crash.


Attention: Save games from earlier beta versions (except beta 4) cannot be continued!

I really hope you will like version 1.11. Feedback, criticism, comments or maybe even nice words are welcome at support@players-eleven.com or here at the Community-Hub. Also check out the discord server, new players are very welcome there!

Stay healthy, play football and have fun!

notes.title: Version 1.10 released
notes.notes:
Version 1.10 is available as of today. Again there are some improvements and bug fixes. The changes:

Improvements[/ h2]
- In the player view you can now see the long-term development of the market value
- You can now play the game without dismissals
- There is a results mode, uninteresting games can now be easily skipped

Balancing[/ h2]
- In contract negotiations with a player, it is now pointed out that the player expects a significant improvement in the conditions
- The stadium rental now adapts to the league.
- Fan calculation revised: These now adjust more realistically to the successes and failures of the club
- The 'eleven of the day' was revised again

Bug fixes [/ h2]

- Confidence calculation of the chairman: The bonus points for past successes are now correctly calculated
- Spectator calculation: Fixed calculation error that 0 spectators always come to a dilapidated stadium
- Contract bug: Sometimes the game crashed during a contract negotiation with a player. This bug has been fixed
- Player duplicates no longer occur
- Abort when viewing the club premises: Sometimes the game crashed when viewing the club premises. This bug has been fixed


Unfortunately, I have not yet managed to revise the 'creating a new club' so that you are the chairman yourself, because there is really a lot to adapt to the game logic (budgets, news, stadium expansion, stadium sale / buyback, bankruptcy, etc.). So it's not in this update yet, but I'm working on it.

Although new data is required for the savegame, old savegames can still be played (simply upgrade the corresponding savegame from version 1.09 to version 1.10 in the loading screen).

Feedback, criticism, comments etc. as always like to post in the community hub or send me a message at support@players-eleven.com.

I hope you have fun with version 1.10

notes.title: Player's Eleven New Update to Version 1.09
notes.notes:
VERSION 1.09 RELEASED!

Today is the release of the biggest update in the history of Player's Eleven! I received numerous suggestions via email and the CommunityHub. You can now view the result of this with the latest version 1.09. At this point, a big thank you to all players who have reached me and made suggestions to improve the game.

Since all teams now have individual kits, the editor had to be adjusted. Own edited databases can be used without problems. The kits can be integrated into your own databases. All you have to do is create a folder called "kits" in the relevant country folder in "badges". The kits can then be copied in there. The kits must have the same file name as the badges of the corresponding clubs.

New variables are required for the game itself, which must also be saved. Therefore, a new game must unfortunately be started. However, I hope that the extensive improvements compensate for this.

If you have any feedback, questions or other concerns, please send an email to support@players-eleven.com. And now I wish you a lot of fun with the latest version!

The following changes have been made:

IMPROVEMENTS

 Each club now has its own individual kit
 New and nicer badges for the clubs. Now the club colors are right too
 New and better menu icons
 Completely revised half-time screen
 The preliminary reports, the live game, the half-time screen and the follow-up reports can now also be started and closed with the ENTER key. In the live game you can also open and close the halftime screen with ESC (changes are discarded with ESC, adopted with ENTER)
 The half-time screen now shows the previous substitutions and changes. A new symbol also shows which player you have just drawn onto the field
 New picture for the draws
 The squad menu now shows at a glance how the rating of the players has changed compared to the start of the season
 When you start a new game, an indicator shows that the game is creating the necessary things and you have to wait a short moment
 With the settings in the main menu and with countries, competitions, clubs, players and employees you can now leave the screen with a red X. So far, this was only possible with the right mouse button.
 The menu shows the name of the current menu, as well as the menu that you are currently hovering over
 The chairman now explains the current situation of the club for each new season and gives tips on what could be changed. From year 2 onwards you can also see how some things have changed in the club compared to the previous year (number of fans, reputation, etc.)
 In the tactics menu you can see at a glance the number of appearances of the players in the current season
 In the contract menu you can now see the date a player leaves the club
 If you buy a player and your club is the only interest, you can now adjust the contract details so that they meet the player's requirements
 News: The chairman announces that the transfer windows would soon close in August and January. He also informs you if a player has injured himself seriously during training. He also informs at the end of the season if there are still players or employees whose contract expires at the end of the season
 Display of the European Cup tables in the live game and in the follow-up report
 In the live game of a league game you can now see the graphic elements of the table that characterize the European Cup positions and relegation places
 Graphical revision of the review report screen. In addition, there is now an “team of the day” on every match day


BALANCING

 The confidence of the board of directors accumulated in one season is now weighted a little more strongly in the coming season if the round is successful
 During training, the likelihood that a player will be injured is slightly less
 A player's rating doesn't decrease quite as much with a long injury
 At the end of the season, only the best 10-12 offers are displayed for the new offers from other clubs


BUGFIXES

 If you have canceled all negotiations with sponsors, then you can continue playing
 All round names in live play are now correct
 Design bugs in the European Cup draws have been fixed
 The employee contract extensions are now correct, as are the severance payments
 At the end of the season, all non-accepted contractual offers from other clubs will be deleted
 Displaying a player's number of goals in the live game is now correct in all competitions, not just for the league
 The ratingof the youth players is now correct

notes.title: Small Update
notes.notes:
Today there is a small update for update 1.08:


 Players can now be placed on the transfer market directly from the player page
 You can now select "Only foreign countries" on the transfer market
 There is now a "quick line-up" for tactics, in which the coach immediately selects a lineup and tactics
 After the half-time break, it continues immediately and you no longer have to press "kick off"
 Player negotiations have been adjusted: Players are now asking for slightly lower salaries


In addition, I unfortunately had to change the use of badges in the editor. You can no longer copy badges of any size into the corresponding folder, but they must have the size 125x125 ("big") and 30x30 ("small"). The scaling in the game was unfortunately too bug-prone for some graphics cards. If the badge is clearly displayed too large in the game, the corresponding files must be scaled down. You can continue to use self-edited data without problems.

notes.title: Version 1.08 - President's confidence revised
notes.notes:
The new update brings some minor changes:

- The calculation of confidence by the president has been revised. For some criteria, the president judged clearly too strictly, so that it could sometimes happen that you were fired despite good performances. This has now been adjusted. You can continue to play with your old savestate, but the confidence will may be change significantly after the next match day. I recommend starting a new game.
- Two bug fixes have been removed from the sound, which sometimes caused the game to crash. This will no longer happen.
- Some texts have been revised so that longer club names are not written out if there is not enough space, but are abbreviated with two points at the end.

As always: If you have an idea to improve the game or something needs to be adjusted in your opinion, just post it in the CommunityHub or send me an email at support@players-eleven.com

notes.title: Version 1.07
notes.notes:
The latest version brings a few minor changes:


 Detailed player development: You can now see how each player's rating, condition and freshness have changed over the season.
 Training effects: With just a few clicks, the team's training values ​​can be displayed as a graphic. This makes it easy to see what progress the team has made over a long period of time.
 Further revisions to player freshness: Older players are usually less fresh at the end of the season than younger players.
 Graphical view of the development of the board trust, the account balance and the club value
 Small bug fixes
[/ list]

Since new values ​​are loaded and saved, a new save state must be created.

Have fun with version 1.07!

notes.title: Player's Eleven Update!
notes.notes:
Better live game!
New graphics for a more varied live game. New sound effects that create a better stadium atmosphere. The fans sing, cheer or hiss at your team. The player values ‚condition‘ and ‚fitness‘ have been completely revised.

Off to Scandinavia and the Czech Republic!
Oslo, Copenhagen, Stockholm or the Golden City? With Norway, Denmark, Sweden and the Czech Republic, four other countries were added. Choose a team from a total of 20 European countries.

Player’s Eleven is becoming more user-friendly!
There are now info points all over the game that provide you with useful information. You will find out, for example, how to find the right players for your tactics or the difference between the three fan-types. This makes it much easier to get into the game.

What else?
Revised game balancing in many fields. Improved attendance calculation and more realistic transfer activities of the computer clubs. From now on, other clubs will also show an increased interest in you if you and your team have had a successful season.

Try it out and get Player’s Eleven now!

notes.title: Version 1.03.
notes.notes:
- Added new countries and leagues: Belgium, Switzerland, Austria, Greece, Ireland, Poland, Portugal, Russia, Scotland, Netherlands and Turkey

- New database system: Easy addings of external databases, and creating new databases. These can be selected in the game to start with.

notes.title: Version 1.03 released! New Countries & Leagues added!
notes.notes:
Next update to version 1.03 is released! New countries and leagues were added: Belgium, Greece, Ireland, Netherlands, Austria, Poland, Portugal, Russia, Scotland, Switzerland and Turkey.

Also, in the editor and the game there is now the possibility to save and load different databases, giving the option to add new databases to the game, either by creating them or just copying them in the specific game folder.

I hope you'll enjoy the new leagues!

Sporty regards!

notes.title: Version 1.02
notes.notes:
Two changes were made, both thanks to feedback from the players in the communityhub or via e-mail!

1) Now there is an overview of the player's attributes in the 'squad' and 'tactics' screen, providing an easy way for comparing the player's stats. The overview is divided in stats for goalkeepers and field players

2) Resdesign of the livegame. I did a complete redesign of the live game, now centering the game right in the middle of the screen and not longer on the left side. I also added some few graphics to spice it up a little.

Thanks to all the players, who did get in contact with me about this game. As always: If you have any ideas of improving this game, just let me know: support@players-eleven.com

Sporty Regards!

notes.title: Version 1.01
notes.notes:
- Bugfix: Players bought from another club will join your squad at the correct time of the transfer window
- Bugfix: A player with a Fix Transfer Fee will leave your club if you lose the negotiation against an other club
- Bugfix: The game crashes no longer when you sell a player and you were in the menue of your players contracts
